mrr_by_plan.description: Active MRR, accounts, and seats by plan — the first stop for revenue, plan-mix, and expansion questions.

columns.plan: Subscription tier: starter, team, business, or enterprise
columns.accounts: Active (not canceled) accounts on the plan
columns.seats: Total licensed seats on the plan
columns.mrr: Monthly recurring revenue from active accounts on the plan
columns.avg_mrr: MRR divided by active accounts on the plan

churn_risk.description: One row per account with lifetime, MRR, and churn state — the first stop for churn, retention, and at-risk questions.

columns.mrr: Monthly recurring revenue for the account
columns.churned: 1 if the subscription has been canceled, else 0
columns.lifetime_days: Days from subscription start to cancellation (or today if active)

feature_adoption.description: Weekly feature usage by region — the first stop for engagement, adoption, and product-usage questions.

columns.feature: Product area: dashboards, reports, api, exports, or alerts
columns.active_accounts: Distinct accounts using the feature that week

accounts.description: Master account list with industry and geography.

subscriptions.description: One subscription per account, with plan, seats, MRR, and churn dates.

columns.canceled_at: Cancellation date; NULL while the subscription is active

columns.events: Number of times the feature was used
